duration.text: The Obstetrics and Gynecology at Jinzhou Medical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applica 3.Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 5.Copy pages of your passport First 7 blank visa pages and Visa Record Page of Your Passport 6.Resume Written in Chinese or in English 7.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: 1. University degree 2. Having passed the postgraduate entrance examination 3. Minimum 2 recommendations from associate professors
